summary: Russell seized control at Zandvoort by claiming sprint pole ahead of McLaren's Norris and Ferrari's Leclerc, signaling Mercedes' intent to wrestle momentum from the championship leaders heading into the weekend. Antonelli's pace in Friday practice suggests the young Mercedes driver could disrupt the established order, while Red Bull faces complications with Hadjar sidelined by injury, forcing tactical adjustments for a team already under pressure. A decisive result here could reshape the title fight as F1 prepares for Zandvoort's farewell as a permanent calendar fixture.
